notes: Primary source: Telos Alliance official Z/IP ONE product page (spec table for model with Analog + AES/EBU + Livewire I/O, PN 2001-00289). Cross-checked against the official Z/IP ONE User's Manual (Oct 2013, v1.9.0r) for pinouts, panel labels ("CH 1 In"/"CH 2 In" etc.), and confirmation of 1RU (1.75in) form factor, IEC power inlet (100-240VAC 50-60Hz internal switching supply), DB25 GPIO pinout (8 outputs/8 inputs, +5V, ground), USB-A pinout, and RJ45 100BASE-T pinout. Note: the manual reviewed only exposed "Analog XLR" or "Livewire" as audio-input-source menu choices (no AES option shown in that menu screenshot), which may reflect a non-AES base SKU or an earlier firmware revision predating the AES source-select option — however the manufacturer's current spec page for this model lists AES/EBU I/O as standard, so it is included here with high confidence. GPIO/parallel connector is physically a 25-pin D-sub (DB25); no exact match exists in the provided connector-id list, so "rs232" was used as the closest D-sub-style placeholder — this is a contact-closure/GPIO port, not a serial RS-232 data port. True RS-232 serial pass-through on this device is achieved via an external USB-to-serial adapter on one of the two USB-A ports, not a dedicated serial connector. No bandwidth/version grade is stated for the USB ports (omitted). Rack width is standard 19in with 1RU (1.75in) height; unit ships without an internal fan.

ports.name: CH 1 In
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input, left channel; line/mic/mic+phantom selectable

ports.name: CH 2 In
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input, right channel; line/mic/mic+phantom selectable

ports.name: CH 1 Out
ports.note: Balanced analog audio output, left channel

ports.name: CH 2 Out
ports.note: Balanced analog audio output, right channel

ports.name: AES/EBU In
ports.note: Stereo AES/EBU digital input, 24-bit with sample rate conversion

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: Also carries Livewire audio-over-IP and local control/GPIO

ports.name: WAN
ports.note: Recommended port for IP-codec streaming to the internet

ports.name: Parallel (GPIO)
ports.note: Actual connector is a 25-pin D-sub (DB25 male) with 8 open-collector outputs + 8 open-collector inputs for time-aligned contact closures, plus +5V and ground; no D-sub/DB25 id exists in the allowed connector list so rs232 was chosen as the closest D-sub analog. This is NOT an RS-232 serial port.

ports.name: USB 1
ports.note: For approved Wi-Fi/3G/4G modems or USB-serial adapter (RS-232 pass-through); USB speed generation not stated in spec

ports.name: USB 2
ports.note: For approved Wi-Fi/3G/4G modems or accessories; USB speed generation not stated in spec

ports.name: Headphone (1/4")
ports.note: Front-panel monitor output, selectable between receive and transmit audio

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC receptacle with internal fuse; auto-ranging 90-240VAC (mfr page) / 100-240VAC (manual), 50-60Hz
